purpose: Raw readings; potentially unbounded partitions; baseline only.
read_cql_template: SELECT driver_system_id, sensor_name, event_ts, event_id, sensor_reading, padding FROM ts0_series_raw WHERE driver_system_id = ? AND sensor_name = ? AND event_ts >= ? AND event_ts <= ?;
write_cql_template: INSERT INTO ts0_series_raw (driver_system_id, sensor_name, event_ts, event_id, sensor_reading, padding) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);
preprocessing: Use original event time as epoch milliseconds; no physical time bucket.
access_requirements: A sensor-name-only read needs a complete station identity enumeration; no ALLOW FILTERING.
Perform one read per station and each of two temporal windows; deduplicate by event_id only if same logical event.
maintenance_requirements: Insert every input observation; preserve payload padding and stable event_id.

purpose: Raw observations grouped into 3600-second UTC buckets, by fully identified sensor stream.
read_cql_template: SELECT driver_system_id, sensor_name, event_ts, event_id, sensor_reading, padding FROM ts1_series_3600s WHERE driver_system_id = ? AND sensor_name = ? AND bucket_start_ms = ? AND event_ts >= ? AND event_ts <= ?;
write_cql_template: INSERT INTO ts1_series_3600s (driver_system_id, sensor_name, event_ts, event_id, sensor_reading, padding, bucket_start_ms) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);
access_requirements: Enumerate stations for sensor-name-only predicate before reads.
Split BOTH 5-second windows into all intersected UTC bucket partitions.
Inclusive endpoints require bucket intersection at boundaries; client merges complete result.
maintenance_requirements: Write each observation to its UTC bucket; stable event_id makes retried inserts idempotent.

purpose: Alternate projection across all stations for selected sensor name, 3600-second UTC buckets.
read_cql_template: SELECT driver_system_id, sensor_name, event_ts, event_id, sensor_reading, padding FROM ts3_sensor_3600s WHERE sensor_name = ? AND bucket_start_ms = ? AND event_ts >= ? AND event_ts <= ?;
write_cql_template: INSERT INTO ts3_sensor_3600s (driver_system_id, sensor_name, event_ts, event_id, sensor_reading, padding, bucket_start_ms) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);
access_requirements: Direct sensor-name and temporal partition access; no station enumeration.
Query BOTH 5-second intervals and all intersected buckets, including inclusive endpoints.
Output includes station identity for correct multistation semantics.
maintenance_requirements: A complete workload deployment must write each observation to this projection alongside the chosen canonical source.
Extra storage and fanout are NOT free; quantify in Stages 6/7/9.
